verdict.rationale: Auth0's own docs say customers can choose where data lives through Private Cloud deployments on AWS and Azure. The Azure page cites a choice of 60+ regions 'to meet your data residency requirements.' The evidence ties region choice to the dedicated Private Cloud offering, though, and nothing shows region selection for standard public-cloud tenants. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for standard tenants, a list of AWS regions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Choose among Azure's 60+ regions to store customer data, and meet your data residency requirements.

Compare Auth0 Private Cloud-managed service deployment options on AWS and Azure to choose a dedicated, isolated environment that meets your data-residency, performance, and guaranteed RPS requirements
